# Ryan Berlin

> Ryan Berlin is an indie pop and alternative musician based in Melbourne, Australia. His music pairs dreamy synths and propulsive electronic beats with driving, psychedelic electric guitars: uplifting, confident and dreamy.

Reclusive raconteur. Hard yet soft, light yet heavy; routinely disenchanted, yet never for long. Ryan is a philanthropist of small mercies, an unesteemed writer, and dilettante of oddities.

## Genres and moods
- Genres: indie pop, indie, alternative, indie rock, indie electropop, psychedelic rock, dream pop, synth-pop, synthwave
- Moods: dreamy, uplifting, confident, inspirational, emotional, energetic
- Instruments: synthesiser, electric guitar, bass guitar, electronic drums, drum kit

## Releases
- Models (Paradox of Choice) — forthcoming, December 2026
- Refurbished — forthcoming, 2027
- EP (2018) — tracks: Alone, Flying Fish, Sea Saw, Loafing. Free to stream and download: https://ryanberlin.bandcamp.com/album/ep
